rows.en: So this is the friend we came for?
Yes. Pigmon is a friendly kaiju.
Hmph, really? A kaiju like this?
Auuh! Aauh!! Auuh!!
It's saying, "Don't judge by appearances. You're the suspicious-looking one."
Hah!?
If we're done here, let's hurry back.
The heroes took Pigmon back with them to the Celestial Being camp.
The heroes took the friend they rescued back with them to the Celestial Being camp.
Thank you for rescuing Pigmon.
Pigmon has been very cooperative with us, gathering valuable information for us all along.
I see.
I'll be fine on my own from here-pi.
...Hm? I see. All right.
Pigmon says it's going out on patrol.
Pigmon always heads out alone, and every time, it comes back with some kind of information for us.
Time for me to get going-pi!
Right, take care!
Pigmon toddled off and disappeared somewhere.
Thank you so very much. If anything comes up again, we'll be counting on you.
Yeah. Here's hoping Pigmon doesn't get caught by the enemy again.
Completed the quest "Antlar Strikes Again".
Pigmon is trying to pass on some important information.
Everyone! I've been waiting for you.
Au-au!! Au-au!!
I can't make heads or tails of what it's saying...
It seems Pigmon has gotten hold of new information.
So what's Pigmon saying?
Just a moment, please.
Hikari entrusted me with a "Pan-Space Interpreter."
And what's that?
A translator for every language in space. He said that with it, we should understand Pigmon.
Pigmon, could you tell us everything again from the beginning?
Pigmon understood Maganac's request and began to speak.
Alien Baltan is getting ready to wipe out the Ultra Warriors-pi!
What!!
Alien Baltan is a scary enemy with a grudge against the Ultra Warriors-pi!
So where is Alien Baltan now?
North of the quarry in Hideout Cube-pi.
That's where the Ultra Warriors were crucified, isn't it?
IF YOU GO, TAKE ULTRA WARRIORS. OTHERWISE, THEY WILL NOT APPEAR.
Understood. Pigmon, thank you.
Then please head north of the quarry, as Pigmon's information says.
Ultraman must be in the party to progress this quest.
Please bring the Ultra Warriors with you. This request concerns them.
Fo, fo, fo, fo, fo...
There you are!! Alien Baltan!!
There you are!! Alien Baltan!!
There you are!! Alien Baltan!!
There you are!! Alien Baltan!!
There you are!! Alien Baltan!!
...So this is Alien Baltan.
Ultraman, so you've come to me of your own accord.
You've saved me the trouble.
Ultraman, thanks to you and your kind, many of my brethren have been turned to space dust.
Protecting peaceful planets from invasion is our mission!!
You who scheme to invade Earth have no right to say that!!
Protecting Earth from invaders is our mission!!
That was to protect the Earth!!
Who are invaders like you lot to talk!!
Silence!! Now, at last, I'll have my revenge!!
Curse you...!!
...But this is not over. Ultraman... prepare yourself...!!
...Alien Baltan. He'll surely show up again.
...Alien Baltan. He'll surely show up again.
...Alien Baltan. He'll surely show up again.
...Alien Baltan. Is he going to appear before us again?
You plan to challenge us again? Fine! Bring it on!!
Just then, Pigmon appeared.
Au-au-au!!
Pigmon!!
Pigmon!!
Pigmon!!
Pigmon!!
Pigmon!!
YOU ALL. WHAT HAPPENED WITH ALIEN BALTAN?
Relax, Pigmon. We defeated Alien Baltan.
Relax, Pigmon. We defeated Alien Baltan.
Hikari...!! So that's how it is.

notes.note: Quest009.bla maps TextIdOffset+N to row N (as quest_009 found). Row 127 is the last of the unreferenced 10-row non-Ultra leader block 118-127 (slot 14 = OOO); same English as 118-126.

Rows 128 and 135-138 are not referenced by Quest009.bla (the no-Ultra branch goes +114, +116, +139). Leftovers of a version where Pigmon could not talk: 128 polite reply (speaker unknown), 135/138 rude doubter (Ankh-like), 136 Pigmon's cry, 137 someone interpreting Pigmon's cry (polite; 'it' for Pigmon, g=n).
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36, +139), both branches.
Narration. +141 plays when the leader is an Ultra (they recognised Pigmon), +142 otherwise ('the friend they rescued'). 'Friend' matches quest_009's rendering of the ally.

Played at camp: Maganac 143/144/149/151, Pigmon 146/150, narration 152. 151 is under Maganac's name box in the script, so his casual send-off is to Pigmon. Unreferenced: 145 (short ack, speaker unknown), 147-148 (someone, likely Maganac, relaying Pigmon's words), 153 (Maganac-style polite thanks), 154 (rough party voice).
Unreferenced. Direction of yoroshiku: Maganac asking the heroes to help again, so 'we'll be counting on you'.
OkWin +156. Title from QuestMess 0.10 'Antlar Strikes Again'; format as quest_007.
Quest description row (no speaker). Quest title in QuestMess 0.11 is 'A Strange Visitor'.

Quest010.bla maps TextIdOffset+N to row N+1 (rows 2-5 empty). Verified: Maganac +5/+8/+18/+20/+24/+25 = rows 6/9/19/21/25/26, Pigmon (CHARA_NAME 267) +17/+19/+21 = rows 18/20/22, OkWin +26 = row 27, Baltan (266) +32/+40-42/+49/+51/+52 = rows 33/41-43/50/52/53, Ankh +38 = row 39 and +95/+97 = rows 96/98, Ultraman (11) +44/+54 = rows 45/55. No party-leader branches in this script.

Rows 7-8 and 10-17 are unreferenced: an earlier version of the scene in which Maganac uses Hikari's universal translator. Speakers inferred: 7/16 Pigmon, 8/10 party members, 11/12/14/15 Maganac (polite), 13 curt voice (Ankh-like), 17 narration. In the played version Maganac's 'I've been waiting' (6) leads straight to 'Pigmon has new info' (9) and Pigmon speaks directly.
The source sets the device name in double corner brackets; rendered as a quoted item name 'Pan-Space Interpreter' (Ultra series device). Not in the glossary.
Maganac quoting Hikari ('dato' = so he said); Hikari g=m.
Pigmon's sentence-final 'ppi' as a '-pi' suffix, as in quest_009.
Played under Maganac's name box (+18) even though it reads like a party reaction; kept neutral so it works for him.
Brackets around the Cube name dropped for a place name; 'Hideout Cube' per glossary and QuestMess.
Rows 23-24 unreferenced. 23 Maganac (polite); 'crucified' as in the story (MainEventMess0317 etc.).

Katakana-with-kanji speech (rows 24, 71 and, in the next slice, 78/85-87): Pigmon speaking through the Pan-Space Interpreter, a stiff machine-translated voice. Rendered in all caps, no contractions, to mark it. Unreferenced by the script. 'They' = Alien Baltan's side.
OkWin +26 (system). Format as quest_007.
Unreferenced; Maganac (polite). 'Them' = the Ultra Warriors.
Alien Baltan's laugh, glossary 'Fofofofo'.

Rows 34-38 unreferenced 5-row block (one per Ultra leader: Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero, the order used in Quest009); identical Japanese, identical English. The played event uses Ankh's row 39 instead.
'Kisama-tachi' = Ultraman and his fellow Ultras: 'you and your kind'.
Ultraman (CHARA_NAME 11, +44). Rows 46-49 are an unreferenced reply block in the same Ultra order: 46 Seven, 47 Taro, 48 Mebius, 49 Zero (rough 'omaera').
Ultraman (+54). Rows 56-59 unreferenced, same Ultra order: 56 Seven, 57 Taro, 58 Mebius ('boku-tachi'), 59 Zero. Baltan g=m.

Rows 64-87 and 89 are all unreferenced: a cut ending in which Pigmon returns wearing Hikari's interpreter. 64 narration, 65 Pigmon's cry, 66-70 one 'Pigmon!!' per Ultra leader, 71 Pigmon via interpreter (caps), 72-77 leader reactions.

Unreferenced; speaker unknown (an Ultra realising Hikari's interpreter is why Pigmon can talk). The 72-77 run (A A H A H A) does not split into five clean leader slots; each row translated on its own, identical Japanese kept identical.

report: 80/80 rows. Quest009.bla: +N = row N; Quest010.bla: +N = row N+1 (rows 2-5 empty). Played: Ankh 139/39, Maganac 143/144/149/151 and 6/9/19/21/25/26, Pigmon 146/150 and 18/20/22, Baltan 33/41-43/50/52/53, Ultraman 45/55. Unreferenced (speakers inferred): 009 rows 127-128, 135-138, 145, 147-148, 153-154; 010 rows 7-8, 10-17, 23-24, 29, 34-38, 46-49, 56-59, 64-74 (a cut interpreter version of the scene). Style: Pigmon '-pi' suffix as quest_009; interpreter katakana speech in ALL CAPS. New term not in glossary: 'Pan-Space Interpreter'.
